tools.name: calculate_crs_november_2026
tools.description: Estimate the CRS points an Express Entry candidate gains on November 3, 2026, when Canadian work experience becomes the Labour Market Integration factor: unchanged work-length points plus 70/40/20 extra points after 12+ months in a 2×/1.5×/1.3× high-wage occupation, or 100/70/50 points for a job off

tools.name: find_high_wage_occupation
tools.description: Search IRCC's high-wage occupation list (in effect November 3, 2026; 186 NOC 2021 codes) by job title words or NOC code. Returns each match's level (2×, 1.5× or 1.3× the average median wage) and the CRS points it earns. An occupation that isn't listed earns no high-wage or job offer points.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_celpip_practice_question, get_celpip_template · Public sink: get_celpip_practice_question, check_celpip_answers · Destructive: get_celpip_practice_question.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_celpip_practice_question, get_celpip_template · Public sink: get_celpip_practice_question, check_celpip_answers · Destructive: get_celpip_practice_question

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_celpip_practice_question" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
